text_block_list.text:
One day, I was summoned to the Chairwoman's
office "to ensure the success of the URA Finals."
And so, upon stepping inside—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer <username>!
So you're here too...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm begging you...!
Lend me a hand~! Both of you~!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... P-Please calm down.
Let me explain first...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: How regrettable! We made a grand announcement and even requested publicity from various media outlets, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Truth be told...
The URA Finals still lacks widespread recognition
and is not well known to the general public!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! I wish to seize this chance to convey
its charm and heighten everyone's expectations...!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A race packed with smiling fans!
Because that is the very stage where every Umamusume deserves to shine!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman Akikawa... you have my deepest sympathies.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'd love nothing more than to make a move to break the deadlock...
But what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! And so, as exceptional Trainers,
I would like to ask this of you...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A massive promotional event for the "URA Finals"—showcasing the Umamusume pouring their hearts into training for the races—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I wholeheartedly request your participation in the "URA Finals Commemorative Event"!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...?
By the way, what kind of event is it...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...To be completely honest,
I was just desperate trying to pull off the event in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Reckless and planless!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Eeeek!?

"...First, we all decided to have a meeting
about the contents of the event."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My sincerest apologies...! I'm sorry to trouble you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I admit it was confusing at first.
Even so, I have no intention of giving up.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek is also working hard toward
the title of "Finals Champion."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Because we can't let her efforts go to waste...!

My own trainee is doing her best too...
I share the exact same sentiment as Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Appreciation! From the bottom of my heart, appreciation!!!!
As expected of the Trainers I've put my faith in...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Right off the bat!
Does anyone have any input regarding the event details?!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... When it comes to events meant to draw a crowd,
talk shows and mini-lives by Umamusume feel like the classic approach, but...
choice_data_list: That's a heavy burden on the Umamusume...
That's a heavy burden on the Umamusume, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Indeed. This is a crucial period, so I want her to be able to focus on her training.
choice_data_list: I wonder if there's anything we can do on our own.
I wonder if there's anything we can do on our own.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Just by ourselves...?
But, something like that—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... I see!!
I've got it!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "If it's 'the sight of Umamusume pouring their hearts into training for a race', then you girls... Wait, no!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because it's you!
You're the ones who can convey it!!
And on the day of the event—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, and
Trainer Kiryuin! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: We will be featuring today's event extensively in "Monthly Twinkle" as well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
By the way... where are the Umamusume you train?
I was sure you'd be joining the event with them...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the event will just be the two of us.
However, rest assured about the quality of the content!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Today, we will share the stories of the girls
working hard towards the URA Finals.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been watching right by her side this whole time...
and precisely because I'm not her, there are things only I can talk about!
choice_data_list: I'll do my best on their behalf today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I see...!?
Well, that... that is quite something...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That heartfelt care, putting the hard-working Umamusume first every single day!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume need rest too...!
We'll work hard in their place...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Describing their sparkling, sweat-drenched daily efforts in vivid, captivating detail! And then—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So you're prepared to do the handshake events, talk shows, and mini-lives in the Umamusume's place, then?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I will deliver the trainers' feelings
straight to our readers without fail!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you'd like, shall I help out
as the MC or something!
I'll hype things right up for you~!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh... What...?
And—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, take a look, everyone! Next up is—
a mini-live performance by the two Trainers! ♪

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...
Umapyoi, Umapyoi...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Trainers, keep at it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Putting yourself in the Umamusume's shoes...
I like that spirit!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: The "URA Finals", huh... A new race sounds like so much fun!

"...Though there were unexpected incidents,
we succeeded in making the name of the
'URA Finals' widely known."
